lines.en: Waterweed brushes my pelvic fin.
In the warm water I grow faster.
Tail against the current — that's how I move.

lines.zh: 这片芦苇，我穿过很多次。
lines.en: I have passed through these reeds many times.
I swim along the shallow ditch by the bank.
Riverbed undercurrents are annoying.

lines.zh: 一队同伴从后面跟上来。
lines.en: A line of companions catches up behind me.
Going with the current saves strength.

lines.zh: 拐过这块大石，就是深水。
lines.en: Past this boulder lies the deep water.
River trout, schooling upstream.
I skim forward over the river sand.
The water is slack in the bend; I catch my breath.
The river's colder than yesterday. My gills know.
I beat my tail against the upstream flow.
The water in the rock crevices is cooler.
In warm water, I swim harder.

lines.zh: 水面咕噜一声，是在唱歌。
lines.en: The water gurgles; that's it singing.
Cold river water suits me.

lines.zh: 下游有木头撞石头的声音。
lines.en: Downstream, wood knocks against stone.

lines.zh: 小鱼围着我打转，不怕我。
lines.en: Small fish circle me without fear.

lines.zh: 我吹出一串泡，看它散开。
lines.en: I blow a string of bubbles and watch them scatter.
The river surface shines like a sheet of tin.
A water strider walks on the surface.
The reeds sway thin shadows in the water.

lines.zh: 河底的石头，我认得每一块。
lines.en: I know every stone on this riverbed.
The current combs out my fins.
I am counting the leaves of the waterweed.
Counting the river stones, one by one.
A shrimp hides in the rock crevice.

lines.zh: 河里石头上，我歇一会儿。
lines.en: I rest a while on the river stones.
In warm water, I swim slow.

lines.zh: 我贴着河床歇了一会儿。
lines.en: I rested against the riverbed a while.

lines.zh: 你在岸上，影子却在水里。
lines.en: You stand ashore, but your shadow is in the water.
Your reflection enters the water first.
Your hand comes in, and the water trembles.

lines.zh: 河底的光，被你的影子吃了。
lines.en: Your shadow swallowed the riverbed light.
I swim half a circle pressed to your side.
Are you looking at my scales?
The shadow you bring is too black.
Don't dangle your hand in the river.
I always remember river cold.
The current pushes me; I hold against it.
The water is too shallow; I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 河水的凉，从我鳃边过去。
lines.en: River cold slips past my gills.
My trout scales got knocked off.
Who's knocking on my back?
My fins shine brighter in warm water.
A scale came off. It hurts.

lines.zh: 暖水海洋太热，我喘不上气。
lines.en: Warm ocean water leaves me breathless.
That blow left me dazed.

lines.zh: 水里的血味，是我自己的。
lines.en: The blood in the water is mine.
I beat my tail to keep from sinking.
Those crumbs are mine.

lines.zh: 你沿河走一步，我就追一步。
lines.en: You step along the river, and I follow.

lines.zh: 水面上有虫子落下，我看见了。
lines.en: A bug fell on the water; I saw it.
Against the current, I beat my tail.

lines.zh: 河流的石头后，我躲一下。
lines.en: Behind a river stone I hide a while.
That smell makes me restless.
Just one bite; no harm.

lines.zh: 那点碎屑，让我从石头后探出头。
lines.en: Those crumbs bring me out from behind the stone.

lines.zh: 闻着像虫子，我上去看看。
lines.en: Smells like a bug; I'll take a look.
My tail moved first.

lines.zh: 我在凉水里，鳍扇得很稳。
lines.en: In cold water my fins beat steady.
That time I nearly turned belly-up.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了水面，我的鳞都乱了。
lines.en: You broke the surface and my scales are in disarray.
I dodged late; my fin scraped you.
Even the waterweed swayed with it.
I slapped rings across the surface.
I swim upstream through cold water.
You numbed my lateral line.

lines.zh: 河底的沙被我们扬起来。
lines.en: We stirred up the river sand.
You come at me like a sunken log.
I know the river's cold best.
You kicked my tail fin.

lines.zh: 河底的卵石，正好藏我的影。
lines.en: River pebbles hide my shadow.
This stretch of river is enough for us.

lines.zh: 河底的卵石间，我们并排。
lines.en: Among the riverbed stones, we lie side by side.
Your tail stirs up fine sand.
Side by side, fin against fin.
Follow me; the water is warm there.
Under the pebbles, I saved you a place.
You circle, and so do I.
By the waterweed, there is only us.

lines.zh: 河湾的浅滩，我清了石子。
lines.en: I cleared the pebbles in the shallow bend.
I can turn the riverbed stones.
I pin it under a pebble.
Carrying it, I can't swim fast.
Whatever sinks to the bottom is mine.
Waterweed tangled it; I work it loose.
This will line my nest just right.
A shiny bit caught on my fin.
That glitter on the riverbed is mine.
I nudge it with my snout.
This pebble has a nice color.
Locked on, inside this ripple.
The cold riverbed is what I know best.
I saw the shadow in the water first.
The fish in this creek are mine.

lines.zh: 河里那条小的，我先看了一眼。
lines.en: That small one in the river; I saw it first.

lines.zh: 鳃一张一合，我准备好了。
lines.en: My gills open and close; I am ready.

lines.zh: 你踩水的声音传得很远。
lines.en: Your wading carries far.
Behind that stone — I saw you.

lines.zh: 这条够我在河里吃一天。
lines.en: This one feeds me a day in the river.
This river holds room for one prey.
Upstream and down, this river is mine.
The water will deliver you to my mouth.

lines.zh: 你一回头，我已换了位置。
lines.en: The moment you turn, I have moved.
I follow the ripples.
One flick of my fin, another foot closer.

lines.zh: 暖水海洋也有我的影子。
lines.en: My shadow passes through warm seas too.

lines.zh: 暖水海洋里，我们成群游。
lines.en: In warm oceans we swim in schools.
Don't climb onto the rocks.
The mud you stir marks your path.
I circle, closing in slowly.

lines.zh: 河底的石头，比我还会躲。
lines.en: The river stones hide better than I do.
I ram you once, then bite.
I aim for the foot you wade with.
In the water, you turn too slowly.

lines.zh: 我窝里的石子，都是挑过的.
lines.en: Every pebble in my nest was chosen.
These teeth are not decoration.
This shallows has no room for you.
Once my teeth close, I don't let go.
You're quick — I'm quicker in water.
My teeth are small but many.
I tumbled down from upstream.
My first breath was all water.

lines.zh: 先深吸一口气……我没有肺。
lines.en: Deep breath first — I have no lungs.
Deep in the waterweed, I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 河底的卵石，我认得每一颗。
lines.en: I know every pebble on this riverbed.
I just broke the egg; my fins are still soft.
The river cooled first, then brightened.

lines.zh: 暖水海洋里，我游得最快。
lines.en: In warm seas, I swim the fastest.
The shallow stones feel rough.

lines.zh: 我跟着鱼群进了这条河。
lines.en: I followed the school into this river.
The water is scalding; my gills burn.
I came down hard on the wet sand.

lines.zh: 我的鳃还在动，可这里没水。
lines.en: My gills still move, but there's no water.
The blast pushed me out of the water.

lines.zh: 箭从水面扎下来，擦过背鳍。
lines.en: An arrow came down through the surface and grazed my dorsal fin.
The spell has soured the water.
So hungry the waterweed curls up.
Lightning hit the river and numbed me to the tail.
My gills are open, but there is no water.
